text_block_list.name: Female Moderator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Meet-and-Greet is finally reaching 
its climax! The Umamusume running in the 
exhibition race are— entering the track 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My race plan is flawless... The crown of 
victory shall be mine!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"E-Even I... want to show you that I can 
do it too...!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You two have incredible spirit! All 
right... Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show the fans too—the feelings 
etched into this racewear!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was around the time when there was 
talk of the URA presenting her with a new 
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when we all went to watch the 
retirement concert of an enka singer who 
was a close friend of her father's.

text_block_list.name: Enka Singer
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply moved that you stayed with me 
until the very end— Thank you so much for 
all your support up until now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That was truly magnificent. A breathtaking 
intensity that felt like she poured 
everything out... It was overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry... Since it's the last 
time, I wanted to cheer for you with a 
smile...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I just... remembered how you used to sing 
together with me when I was little..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That must feel... so lonely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
But you know, she had such a bright smile 
right to the end... It really looked like 
she didn't have a single regret.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"To be able to sing so magnificently even 
at the very end... I bet she had a truly 
happy life as a singer."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Thank you, both of you...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Until the very end, with a smile—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ………… Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Why did that person... have such a radiant 
smile?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm sure a final lap of honor 
must feel lonely."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even though I have to say goodbye to what 
I love so much... I wonder if I can... 
keep smiling through it all...
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because you could take pride in 
the path you walked.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
I think that's why she was smiling until 
the very end.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Pride... I see, that's why she was able 
to stand so proudly, even on her final 
stage.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(...Then what about me? For me to grace my 
final moment in the spotlight with a 
smile...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I want to get everyone hooked. I want to 
give them that festive thrill with my 
running.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure there will be times when I'm 
covered in mud. Even so... I don't want to 
have any regrets about this dream.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(So that I, too, can hold my head high 
right until the very end—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Come to think of it, I'm getting 
a new Racewear, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to consult with you and 
Dia-chan to make it, but... Would it be 
alright if I thought about it by myself?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to face it, think it through... 
and engrave it. My feelings of celebrating 
the final glorious stage with a smile... 
Into my new racing outfit!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Running in this racing outfit, 
please watch... my race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A crown as proof of brilliance. A compass 
so you never lose sight of your goal— I 
poured my feelings into each and every 
one.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The feelings etched into this racing 
attire... They are—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To shine on everyone, every single moment! 
I want to shine with all my might!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, I'm sure that even in my 
final race, I'll be able to take pride in 
the path I've walked—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please sear Kitasan Black's way of life 
into your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan's Fan
text_block_list.text:
U... Uwooooohh!! Kitasan, you're the best 
everrr~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san, your resolve... It was truly 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That was a dazzling display of resolve, 
wasn't it? Fufu, she really showed us—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Kura-chan, Cheval-chan. No matter who 
my opponent is, I'll sprint down this 
glorious path with everything I've got 
until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So Trainer— please watch over my running!
choice_data_list: I'll make sure you keep shining forever!

I'll see you off all the way to the end of 
your final walk.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So Trainer— please watch over my running!
choice_data_list: I'll make sure you keep shining forever!

I'll see you off all the way to the end of 
your final walk.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I trust you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer is by my side... I feel like I 
can shine brighter than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll continue to be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So I can walk down a path I can be proud 
of... I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When the time comes for my final 
hurrah someday ...I definitely want you by 
my side.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"So until then, I'm really counting on 
your support, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! ...Though I'm sure that's 
still a long way off in the future.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I will simply keep pushing 
forward... So that I leave no regrets 
behind on this path!
